name: cache-warm
description: Keeps this session's prompt cache warm while you step away, and stops at the break-even point so it can only ever save tokens.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto: ping until the cost of pinging equals one cold rewrite (times stopFraction), then stop. manual: ping for durationMinutes. off: never ping.

intervalMinutes.title: Ping interval (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: Minutes between pings. 0 = automatic: TTL minus a safety margin (4 min on a 5m cache, 55 min on a 1h cache).

durationMinutes.title: Manual duration (minutes)
durationMinutes.description: manual mode only: keep the cache warm this many minutes after your last turn.

stopFraction.title: Stop at fraction of break-even
stopFraction.description: auto mode only: stop at this fraction of the break-even time. 1 = never spend more than one cold rewrite; 0.5 = stop when half of it is spent.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: Which cache TTL your main conversation uses. detect = read it from your settings/env/auth mode.

inputPricePerMTok.title: Base input price override ($/MTok)
inputPricePerMTok.description: Override the base input price in $/MTok (0 = built-in table from the Claude pricing page). Set this for Bedrock if its rates differ.

cacheReadMultiplier.title: Cache-read multiplier override
cacheReadMultiplier.description: Override the cache-read multiplier vs base input (0 = built-in: 0.1, or 0.05 on Opus/Sonnet 5.5, 0.025 on Fable/Mythos 5.1).

endAction.title: When warming stops
endAction.description: What to do when warming stops. lapse: let the cache expire. compact: compact the conversation while the cache is still warm, so the eventual rebuild is small.

blockIdleCompaction.title: Block idle compaction while warming
blockIdleCompaction.description: While warming, skip Claude Code's own idle compaction so the conversation stays intact.

verbose.title: Verbose logging
verbose.description: Log every ping's token usage to the transcript.

showBand.title: Show the band above the prompt
showBand.description: Draw the cache line above the prompt: state, countdown, TTL, pings and savings. /cachewarm band toggles it for a session.
